findings.F1: The book's gain comes from one window. Its daily returns sum to +0.236 over folds B and C, but only +0.00045 once w16 is removed. Its 5 best days sum to +0.355, more than the whole book. The 12 trades in w16 average +22.1 % net, while the 139 trades overall win only 36 % of the time. So the confirmed size (+2.24 % unusual move per case, 10 times the 0.22 % trade cost) is not spread across windows.
findings.F2: Inside the choppy agitated profile the situation is rare and its fall is not clear. The profile covers 4.4 % of the 5-day grid cells. Closes in the top quarter after a negative 5-day return show −3.06 % over 2 days (t −1.83, 28 cases, 25 days) and −8.49 % over 5 days (t −1.51, only 9 cases).
findings.F3: Outside the profile the same situation does fall, but over 1 to 2 days rather than 5. After a negative 5-day return, a close at 0.75–0.9 of the day's range is followed by −1.06 % the next day (t −2.77, 558 cases, 290 days) and −1.76 % over 2 days (t −2.45, 267 cases, 142 days). Over 5 days the top-quarter groups show nothing (t −0.84).
findings.F4: That 2-day fall is graded by the depth of the 5-day fall. Among top-quarter closes after a negative 5-day return outside the profile, the deepest tercile falls −3.45 % (t −2.87, 132 cases, 60 days), the middle tercile −0.99 % (t −1.19) and the shallowest −0.09 % (t −0.17).
findings.F5: The grading holds across all profiles when the fall is scaled by the coin's own swing. Over 2 days, for upper-half closes after a negative 5-day return, the strength regressed on the 5-day return divided by the 30-day swing has slope +0.135 in calm markets (t 3.92, n 420) and +0.086 in agitated markets (t 1.72, n 448). In both, the deepest tercile has a strength of about −0.30 (−2.3 % over 2 days).
findings.F6: The effect needs both the high close and the prior fall:
findings.F7: The fade is larger when the coin swings more. Among top-quarter closes after a negative 5-day return outside the profile, the 2-day move is −3.54 % in the highest swing tercile (t −2.29) against −0.24 % in the lowest (t −0.35). It holds in three of four years: 2018 −3.42 % (t −2.39), 2019 −1.23 % (t −2.33), 2021 −1.77 % (t −1.29), against 2020 +0.18 %.

ideas.idea: In any market, when a coin's daily close sits near the top of that day's high-low range after a 5-day fall, its price falls over the next two days. The deeper the 5-day fall, measured against the coin's own daily swing over the last 30 days, the larger the fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader treats a strong close that interrupts a fresh 5-day slide as a bounce to sell into for two days, and leans harder the deeper the slide was relative to the coin's usual swing.
ideas.name: strong close in slide fades

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, when a coin's daily close sits near the top of that day's high-low range after its 5-day return has been negative, its price falls over the next two days. The deeper the 5-day fall, the larger the fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a range-bound, agitated market holds the fade of a high close after a 5-day fall for two days rather than five, where the move actually shows.
ideas.name: choppy agitated two day fade
